stem.text: Two identical balls are projected vertically upwards from ground level with the same initial velocity. Ball X is in a vacuum and ball Y is in air.
Which statement about the motion of the balls is correct?

A.text: Ball X reaches a greater maximum height and in a longer time than ball Y.

B.text: Ball X reaches a greater maximum height and in a shorter time than ball Y.

C.text: Ball Y reaches a greater maximum height and in a longer time than ball X.

D.text: Ball Y reaches a greater maximum height and in a shorter time than ball X.
